description: Friends of Open Data Pakistan (ODP) publishes a CSV register of about 26,000 government schools of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province with the EMIS code, school name, district, union council, school level (for example primary) and school gender. Coverage: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, Pakistan; the portal record was last modified on 2023-05-03 and the reference year is not stated. Format and access: one CSV file downloadable without registration from the Open Data Pakistan portal, which also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): not stated (the portal record carries no licence field, read on 2026-09-29); cost: free. Caveats: the file has no coordinates, so it must be geocoded or joined by name or EMIS code to be mapped; no licence or description is given on the portal; the column heading for school level is misspelled in the file; enrolment and building condition are absent. Simulation uses: school inventories for shelter and evacuation planning, education-service capacity and accessibility models, and exposure counts by district or union council. Related catalogue records: OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
